title: Free interactive session April 7!
summary: Happening tomorrow, April 7, a free interactive session on research questions that can be investigated in the Musculoskeletal Knowledge Portal! This is held in conjunction with the ASBMR meeting, but you don't need to be registered for the meeting to addend this session.
bodyHtml: Happening tomorrow, April 7, a free interactive session on research questions that can be investigated in the Musculoskeletal Knowledge Portal! This is held in conjunction with the ASBMR meeting, but you don't need to be registered for the meeting to addend this session. Register to attend the session here.
